formulas.name: formula_CurrentDate
formulas.expression: TEXT( DAY(TODAY()) ) & CASE( MOD(DAY(TODAY()), 10), 1, IF(DAY(TODAY()) = 11, "th", "st"), 2, IF(DAY(TODAY()) = 12, "th", "nd"), 3, IF(DAY(TODAY()) = 13, "th", "rd"), "th" ) & " " & CASE( MONTH(TODAY()), 1, "January", 2, "February", 3, "March", 4, "April", 5, "May", 6, "June", 7, "July", 8, "August", 9, "September", 10, "October", 11, "November", 12, "December", "" ) & " " & TEXT(YEAR(TODAY()))

fields.name: PaymentDisplayText
fields.fieldText:
PAYMENT

(Do not deem valid until the DNO application payment has been received)

fields.name: Has_payment_been_made_by_the_DNO
fields.fieldText: Has payment been made by the DNO?
fields.helpText: Payment is only made once the system shows it as complete. Pending should be treated as no payment made.

fields.name: NOTICE_TO_REMOVE_NTR
fields.fieldText:
NOTICE TO REMOVE (NTR)

(If the NTR is not clear and unequivocal the application is invalid)

fields.name: Is_the_written_notice_to_remove_enclosed
fields.fieldText: Is the written notice to remove enclosed?
fields.helpText: Note: If no NTR, the application is invalid.

fields.name: Does_the_NTR_date_given_on_the_Portal_match_the_date_of_the_NTR_document
fields.fieldText: Does the NTR date given on the Portal match the date of the NTR document?
fields.helpText: Note: If the date’s do not match, query this with the DNO.

fields.name: Is_it_a_clear_unequivocal_notice_to_remove
fields.fieldText: Is it a clear, unequivocal notice to remove (or move, relocate divert etc) the line from the land?
fields.helpText: Note: If the notice asks for the lines to diverted or moved, it should be deemed unclear and the application invalid.

fields.name: APPLICATION_Header
fields.fieldText:
APPLICATION

(Any other ambiguous or missing information should be clarified with the DNO before proceeding)

fields.name: Is_the_application_date_within_three_months_of_the_notice_to_remove
fields.fieldText: Is the application date within three months of the notice to remove?
fields.helpText: Note: Although this detail is important to note, if an application is submitted late, it is still accepted as valid.

fields.name: Does_the_application_confirm_the_location_of_the_land_full_address_with_postcode
fields.fieldText: Does the application confirm the location of the land, full address with postcode?
fields.helpText: Note: Refer to the Application description - Full address.

fields.name: Do_the_land_boundaries_match_the_land_registry_documents
fields.fieldText: Do the land boundaries match the land registry documents?
fields.helpText: Note: Compare the application plan and the Official Copy (Title Plan)

fields.name: Is_the_Electric_line_correctly_listed_under_the_asset_schedule
fields.fieldText: Is the Electric line correctly listed under the asset schedule?
fields.helpText: Note: Compare asset schedule to application plan. If "No", explain in the comments.

fields.name: Does_the_application_plan_clearly
fields.fieldText: Does the application plan clearly:

fields.name: Show_the_location_of_the_line
fields.fieldText: Show the location of the line?

fields.name: Show_any_other_lines_crossing_the_land
fields.fieldText: Show any other lines crossing the land?

fields.name: Distinguish_between_proposed_lines_placed_overhead_and_underground
fields.fieldText: Distinguish between proposed lines placed overhead and underground?

fields.name: Distinguish_between_high_and_low_voltage_lines
fields.fieldText: Distinguish between high and low voltage lines?

fields.name: Is_the_land_registered
fields.helpText: Note: If not, then we will need some other form of evidence to show the person who served the NTR is the owner and/or occupier (TP/TR1 form, Bills etc.).

fields.name: Do_the_landowner_s_details_name_and_address_match_the_land
fields.fieldText: Do the landowner’s details (name and address) match the land registry documents?
fields.helpText: Note: Compare the Grantor Information and the Official Copy (Register).

fields.name: Do_the_Land_Register_and_Title_Plan_have_the_same_reference_number
fields.fieldText: Do the Land Register and Title Plan have the same reference number?
fields.helpText: Note: Compare the Land Registry documents. If the reference don’t match query with DNO.

fields.name: StatusofNegotiations
fields.fieldText: Status of Negotiations:

fields.name: Has_the_DNO_confirmed_whether_negotiations_are_in_progress
fields.fieldText: Has the DNO confirmed whether negotiations are in progress?

fields.name: Has_the_DNO_requested_the_application_to_be_held_in_abeyance
fields.fieldText: Has the DNO requested the application to be held in abeyance?

fields.name: Has_the_landowner_signed_a_wayleave_with_the_DNO
fields.fieldText: Has the landowner signed a wayleave with the DNO?

fields.name: Has_the_landowner_inherited_a_necessary_wayleave_in_relation_to_the_specific_ass
fields.fieldText: Has the landowner inherited a necessary wayleave in relation to the specific assets as consented by the SoS?

fields.name: Is_the_previous_wayleave_attached
fields.helpText: Note: Only applicable for applications made in accordance with paras 8(1)(a) and 8(1)(b) of the Electricity Act 1989

fields.name: Is_there_any_information_to_suggest_the_landowner_has_been_accepting_payments_cr
fields.fieldText: Is there any information to suggest the landowner has been accepting payments, creating an implied wayleave?

fields.name: If_an_implied_wayleave_has_been_created_has_the_DNO_provided_proof_of_payments
fields.fieldText: If an implied wayleave has been created, has the DNO provided proof of payments?

fields.name: Is_the_written_notice_to_terminate_enclosed
fields.fieldText: Is the written notice to terminate enclosed?
fields.helpText: Note: Required in all cases for applications made under paragraph 8(1)(b), where an existing agreement exists with the current landowner.

fields.name: If_notice_to_terminate_served_has_the_full_expiration_period_expired
fields.fieldText: If notice to terminate served, has the full expiration period expired?
fields.helpText: Note: The termination period is specified within the wayleave agreement, normally 6 or 12 months. If the period has not expired the application is invalid. Where an implied wayleave exists a similar reasonable period should be given.

fields.name: In_accordance_with_the_Electricity_Act_1989
fields.fieldText: In accordance with the Electricity Act 1989, which part is the application made under (select one):

fields.name: Para_8_1_a_the_expiration_of_the_wayleave_where_the_landowner_has_given_notice_e
fields.fieldText: Para 8(1)(a) – the expiration of the wayleave, where the landowner has given notice either within three months before the end of an agreement or anytime after.

fields.name: Para_8_1_b_the_landowner_has_served_a_NTT_within_the_term_of_the_existing_agreem
fields.fieldText: Para 8(1)(b) – the landowner has served a NTT within the term of the existing agreement or where an implied wayleave exists due to receipt of payments.
fields.helpText: Note: NTT & NTR (two step/notice procedure)

fields.name: Para_8_1_c_change_of_ownership_or_occupation_whereby_an_existing_wayleave_ceases
fields.fieldText: Para 8(1)(c) - change of ownership or occupation whereby an existing wayleave ceases to be binding and NTR served at any time by new landowners.
fields.helpText: Note: NTR only (one notice/step procedure)

fields.name: Are_there_any_comments_from_the_DNO_that_need_to_be_raised_with_the_consent_mana
fields.fieldText: Are there any comments from the DNO that need to be raised with the consent manager?

fields.name: Does_the_application_relate_to_one_parcel_of_land
fields.fieldText: Does the application relate to one parcel of land?

fields.name: Are_there_any_linked_applications_If_yes_please_list_reference_number_s
fields.fieldText: Are there any linked applications? If, yes, please list reference number(s).
fields.helpText: Note: Search the portal on both “Stakeholder (Landowner) Name and Case (Development) Name?

fields.name: Should_this_application_be_treated_as_a_high_priority
fields.fieldText: Should this application be treated as a high priority?
fields.helpText: Note: All applications involving new lines should be treated as a high priority. Please inform the consent manager immediately.

fields.name: Additional_correspondence
fields.helpText: Note: Correspondence between the parties, payment schedules, TP1/TR1 forms etc.

fields.name: Is_the_application_valid
fields.helpText: Note: If No, please briefly explain why the application is invalid in the comments box.

fields.name: If_further_information_requested_has_it_been_received
fields.fieldText: If further information requested, has it been received?
fields.helpText: Note: Please add the date the information was received in the comments box.

fields.fieldText: The NW Checklist (Existing lines) (internal) has been successfully created.
